name: @faber-leaf/addon-litemesh
description: Workspace package for the litemesh builtin addon. It exists so the addon owns its dependency on the sculptcore engine binding instead of the host carrying it (P16 W3b).
//optionalDependencies: Both live inside the sculptcore submodule. optional is the only workspace: field pnpm tolerates when the package is absent (dependencies and devDependencies both hard-fail ERR_PNPM_WORKSPACE_PKG_NOT_FOUND); it still links normally when it is present. See W3b step 1.
